messages:
Maya (CS): quick async — SummitPay webhook renewal delivery failures
Maya (CS): What I did: reproduced delivery 503s in staging, attached sample payloads and headers, opened CS-4567 with logs.
Maya (CS): Blocker: retries exhausted on customer side; they see ~4 attempts then stop. Unsure if this is our outbound worker or gateway behavior.
Maya (CS): Today: need ENG to confirm source of 503s and recommend short-term mitigation for Wed renewal call.
Maya (CS): logs: https://redwood-logs.internal/summitpay/trace/def456 (redacted). header: X-Customer-ID: summitpay
Liam (oncall): on it. Any minimal curl that SummitPay is using so I can reproduce quickly?
Maya (CS): they sent this exact command — pasted for convenience:
```bash
curl -v -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "X-Customer-ID: summitpay" -d '{"event":"invoice.paid","id":"inv_987"}' https://hooks.redwood.com/api/outbound
```
Liam (oncall): I see a small spike of 503s at ~02:12 UTC in gateway metrics; may be backend connection churn. Will tail gateway and lb pools.
Josh (eng): I can look at the runtime workers. Two asks: 1) give me the earliest req id from the trace, 2) if transient, we can flip outbound worker backoff to exponential + jitter (3 retries) as emergency patch.
Maya (CS): req_id=rp-cb7d1e in the trace. CS-4567 has production timestamps too.
Anika (AM): FYI renewal call Wed EOD, if deliverability not fixed we escalate. ETA on mitigation?
Josh (eng): I'll draft PR to change backoff and add a queued retry path: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/820 (WIP). Plan to canary later today.
Liam (oncall): I'll validate pool health and whether a regional fallback is warranted. Report back in ~40m.
Maya (CS): thanks — I'm updating the customer and flagging renewal at risk if unresolved by Tue EOD. Added PR link to CS-4567.
Josh (eng): pinging @eng-reviews for a fast CR once PR is ready. :eyes:
Maya (CS): appreciate it :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: scheduled canary for PR #820 at 16:45 UTC (awaiting manual approval)
